attempted_change: E[x^2]-E[x]^2 cluster stats instead of per-cluster np.mean/np.var
hypothesis: vectorizing regime-classifier mean/var speeds up calibration
reusable_lesson: the regime bottleneck is np.percentile + predict, not mean/var; measured 1.01x, below the 5% meaningful bar — do not retry without addressing quantile

attempted_change: lru_cache(maxsize=8) on load_registry keyed by resolved path
baseline: 9.2 ms per call (1000 calls = 9197.6 ms); health snapshot 0.32s/cadence in YAML parse
hypothesis: memoizing load_registry removes per-cadence YAML re-parse waste
reusable_lesson: static repository config should be parsed once per process; keyed on path so a different path still parses and a restart picks up edits

attempted_change: fingerprint-keyed cache on build_graph (mtime+size of scanned files)
hypothesis: caching the architecture graph removes per-cadence AST re-parse
reusable_lesson: diagnostics that are pure functions of file content should be cached on a content fingerprint; per-cadence AST re-parse of 140+ files is waste
